title: wentyfn's rp
description: texture pack for minecraft 1.21, made in gray theme,  made by myself.
body:
**Gray PvP-Survival RP is a minimalist Minecraft resource pack designed for survival and PvP gameplay. It gives the game a bleak, gray atmosphere and makes combat and survival feel more intense.**

1. Muted, gray-toned textures that create a cold, harsh mood.
2. Clear visual emphasis on weapons and armor for PvP clarity.
3. Simplified blocks and UI so nothing distracts during fights.
4. Lightweight pack — easy to install and perfect for servers.
